commissioned_by: Paul Kilty, 23 September 2026 ("run the brief"), after Julia Krepska of Our Sansar reported UK-only results
budget: No Anthropic API call was made from this session. Every page was read by direct curl; the keyless reader proxy (r.jina.ai) refused anonymous queries from this network with a 401, so it was not used. Pages that a direct fetch could not reach are listed as bot walls for Paul's browser.
dedup: Full read of scraped_grants (2,169 rows, count asserted equal before any comparison), matched on funder name and on normalised apply URL.
note_on_tibet_watch: Nine of the ten staged rows sit at exactly 49 for Tibet Watch. That is the beneficiary primary gate doing its job: the rows are for children, women and girls or people in poverty, and Tibet Watch's beneficiary groups are ethnic minorities and refugees and migrants. The one row that clears, Oak's International Human Rights Programme at 87, is the one aimed at their work.
